observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 216.» (L15) in the right margin; in the locator the 2 is printed broken, like £, and the 6 blotted.
body L19: the title of the image is set in bold and centred; «(4).» is roman.
body L20-L37: the lines stand in a column on the right of the image of the triquetrum.

figure: the image of the triquetrum is redrawn from the print (figures/AB01-PDF0232-F01.tex): the upright FG, prolonged above the ring at F and ending in a short thick foot at G inside the base ABCD; the rule HM turning about the ring at H, marked at the 2nd to the 42nd of nearly equal steps from the centre of the ring: short strokes on its upper side, every fifth longer and numbered 5 to 40, and at the 30th a cross through the rule (K); a bar across its end M; the rule FL turning about the ring at F, with its two sights drawn as small hooks (the second broken in two), and NF its prolongation beyond F.
figure: a speck stands before the number 5 of the rule HM; it is not a sign. The figures of each number are set upright, the second higher than the first, along the slope of the rule.
notes_right L1-L2: «Al-Battānī» is divided between the lines with the hyphen repeated at the head of L2; its two t's are printed without their bars.
notes_right L3: the breathing and the accent of «ὄργανον» are printed together over the omicron, like δ; the kappas of «παραλλακτικόν» are printed in the curly form (ϰ).
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
